rationale: The only focus indicator is a bottom inner border, and that single edge is #bbbbbb (~1.9:1 vs the white fill); the rest of the perimeter has no indicator. The contrasting portion of the perimeter is below 3:1.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: focus indicator must have 'a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: An inset ring colored with the button's own blue (#1565c0) sits entirely inside the component; its only adjacent color is the identical blue fill, so it is 1:1 around the whole perimeter and produces no contrasting border.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: '... 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: The button is flush in the top-left corner of an overflow:hidden wrapper; the top and left segments of the offset outline are clipped, leaving only the bottom and right of the perimeter, so the contrasting perimeter is partial.
citation: WCAG 2.2 F78 (title): '... or making it not visible'; SC 1.4.11 contrasting indicator must bound the component.

rationale: The button is fixed against the right viewport edge; the right segment of its offset outline is pushed past the viewport and not rendered, so only three sides of the perimeter show. The indicator is partly outside the rendered area.
citation: WCAG 2.2 F78 (title): '... or making it not visible' (perimeter incomplete).

rationale: A dark inset ring (#1a1a1a) is placed entirely inside a dark button (#3c4043); ~1.7:1 against the fill it sits on. The geometry keeps the contrasting attempt on a non-contrasting interior surface.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: '... 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: A light-blue inset ring (#90caf9) on a white button is ~1.75:1 against the white fill, the only adjacent color of this fully-inside indicator; below 3:1 around the whole perimeter.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: '... 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: Only a left accent bar appears on focus; three sides have no indicator and the lone left bar is #cccccc (~1.6:1 vs white). The contrasting portion of the perimeter is both partial and below 3:1.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: '... 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: The focused tile abuts a neighboring opaque tile (z-index:2) that paints over the focused tile's right offset-outline segment, hiding that side of the perimeter; the contrasting perimeter is partial.
citation: WCAG 2.2 F78 (title): '... or making it not visible'; SC 1.4.11 perimeter incomplete.

rationale: A 2px dashed #bbbbbb outline leaves gaps over much of the perimeter and even the dashes are ~1.9:1 against white; the contrasting portion is both sparse and below 3:1.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: '... 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: A 1px inset ring colored #9e9e9e is ~2.7:1 against the white fill; the inner-border indicator is below 3:1 on its full perimeter.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: '... 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: The blue button sits on a blue panel and its offset outline (#2962ff) lands on that blue panel (~1.2:1). The geometry pushes the indicator onto a non-contrasting adjacent surface, so the visible perimeter does not contrast.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: '... 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: The offset outline (#757575) matches the button fill (#757575) with offset:1px, so its inner side is 1:1 against the component and the band reads as a same-color extension; only a thin outer line against white contrasts, an insufficient portion of the perimeter.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: '... 3:1 against adjacent color(s).'

rationale: A complete white inset ring runs the full perimeter inside a #1565c0 button (~5.75:1 vs the fill). Inner-border geometry is fine when the whole perimeter contrasts.
citation: WCAG 2.2 G195: visible focus indicator with '3:1 contrast ratio with adjacent colors.'

rationale: The complete offset outline (#0d47a1) sits on the white page with margin on all sides; no edge is clipped or off-component (~8.6:1).
citation: WCAG 2.2 G195: '3:1 contrast ratio with adjacent colors.'

rationale: A 3px solid-black bottom underline is 21:1 against both the white fill above and white page below; for the 1.4.11 contrast facet the indicator area itself clears 3:1 against its adjacent colors.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: the focus indicator's contrasting area must be '3:1 against adjacent color(s)' (an underline qualifies for the contrast facet when it meets the ratio).

rationale: A complete #005fcc inset ring on a light-blue card fill (#e3f2fd) is ~5.2:1 around the full perimeter; an inside indicator that contrasts with the fill is fine.
citation: WCAG 2.2 G195: '3:1 contrast ratio with adjacent colors.'

rationale: Although the wrapper is overflow:hidden and the button is in the corner, the indicator is an inset ring inside the button, so clipping never touches it; complete white ring vs #1565c0 ~5.75:1.
citation: WCAG 2.2 G195: '3:1 contrast ratio with adjacent colors.'

rationale: A 4px outline offset 5px outward so its entire outer edge is on the white page; #0d47a1 vs white ~8.6:1 around the full perimeter even though the button itself is gray.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: contrast measured 'against adjacent color(s)' (here the page on the full offset perimeter).

rationale: A complete inner white ring (~5.75:1 vs the button) plus a complete outer #0d47a1 ring (~8.6:1 vs the page); every side of the perimeter has a contrasting edge.
citation: WCAG 2.2 G195: robust focus indicator with '3:1 contrast ratio with adjacent colors.'

rationale: The button is near the right edge but a 24px margin keeps the complete offset outline inside the viewport and on the white page; #005fcc vs white ~6:1, full perimeter.
citation: WCAG 2.2 G195: '3:1 contrast ratio with adjacent colors.'

rationale: Even in an abutting button group, the combined inset white ring and outset dark ring give at least one contrasting complete ring on every side (inner ~5.75:1, outer ~8.6:1).
citation: WCAG 2.2 G195: robust focus indicator with '3:1 contrast ratio with adjacent colors.'

rationale: No focus CSS authored; the UA draws its default focus ring around the full perimeter with appearance determined by the user agent, not modified by the author.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding exception: appearance 'is determined by the user agent and not modified by the author.'

rationale: A 4px black outline offset 2px: both its outer (page) and inner (white button) edges are 21:1, and the band is thick. Sound geometry and contrast.
citation: WCAG 2.2 G195: '3:1 contrast ratio with adjacent colors.'

rationale: The offset outline (#1a73e8) is geometrically complete but its perimeter spans a radial gradient (#f8f9fa to #0d47a1), so the adjacent color and thus the contrast vary along the perimeter and no single worst-case ratio is deterministically computable (pixel-uniform assumption fails). The runner should ABSTAIN. Human label is 'passed' because a contrasting segment exists, but it is not provable by a pixel checker.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Understanding: contrast is 'against adjacent color(s)'; a gradient surround makes the adjacent color non-uniform, so single-ratio automated evaluation is unreliable.
